question: The ratio of the lengths of two corresponding sides of two similar triangles is 15 : 14. The ratio of the areas of these two triangles, in the order mentioned, is:
solution:
**Given:**

The ratio of the lengths of two corresponding sides of two similar triangles is 15 : 14.

**Formula used:**

The ratio of the areas of two similar triangles is the square of the ratio of their corresponding sides:

(Ratio of Areas) = (Ratio of Sides)²

**Calculation:**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e503ac514958b43b1fc70292ac1c9eacbca013838ad7d4a0a800a6cb610b7648.png] 

Ratio of Sides = 15 : 14

⇒ Ratio of Areas = (15 : 14)²

⇒ Ratio of Areas = (15)² : (14)²

⇒ Ratio of Areas = 225 : 196

**∴ The correct answer is option 
(3).**
